errors.description: The proof claims one can choose sufficiently small A so the time-T isoperimetric lower bound is at least the logistic bound. Under the assumed violation, that comparison is impossible for small A, so (3.3) does not follow.
errors.evidence: The claimed comparison is equivalent to (κ(T)−1)/(κ(0)−1) ≤ e^(−BT)(4πA−κ(T)A²)/(4πA−κ(0)A²). As A→0, the fraction tends to 1 and B≥2, so the right side is at most e^(−2T)(1+o(1)); the contradiction hypothesis makes the left side strictly greater than e^(−2T). The text nevertheless asserts: “since the inequality (2.4) is tight for A → 0, we can choose A sufficiently small” to obtain that comparison.

errors.description: The evolution equation and maximum-principle argument are not defined for I_A as introduced: for fixed A, (2.2) defines I_A as an infimum over curves, hence a scalar depending on A and t, with no r-variable or specified curve-dependent function to which the spatial derivative and maximum principle apply.
errors.evidence: Equation (2.2) defines I_A := inf_Λ L / inf_Λ̄ L̄, while (2.5) contains ∂²/∂r² ln I_A² and says r is the normal direction of Λ. Proposition 3.1 then applies the maximum principle directly to this I_A.

errors.description: The displayed small-A expansion is incorrect: it omits the order-A^(3/2) correction to the square root, so the stated equality does not hold even up to o(A²).
errors.evidence: Expanding the preceding expression gives √(4πA−κA²) = 2√(πA) − κA^(3/2)/(4√π) + O(A^(5/2)). The manuscript instead writes √(4πA−κA³/(4√π)) + o(A²), whose correction to 2√(πA) is only order A^(5/2).
